title: Zesty Dense Moroccan Beef Tagine
description: A rich and earthy Moroccan dish featuring feather blade beef, perfect for a date night, with a dairy-free friendly twist using kombu-cold-extract.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed beef and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the kombu-cold-extract, dried apricots, prunes, ras el hanout, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the tagine or Dutch oven and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
